summary: Customer Usage Insights service [DES-001]: changes required. It reads the CIS billing database directly (STD-INT-02) and polls MDM interval tables (STD-INT-04), sends customer names and usage to an unapproved GenAI vendor (STD-AI-01) and states no data classification (STD-DATA-01). Reuse the existing Customer Lookup API [API-001] and Interval Usage API [API-007] via the gateway.
